acceptance: Every production owner image builds from the sealed source bundle with pinned bases and dependency locks.
The evidence records the resulting image ID, byte size, source manifest hash, and build exit code.
The owner unit and focused safety suites pass from the sealed source bytes.
Named skips are enumerated and none covers a production capability claimed by this candidate.
Fresh pinned PostgreSQL exercises schema creation, single-writer fencing, delegated worker leases, idempotency, and restart recovery.
A stale coordinator or delegated worker cannot mutate canonical state after promotion.
Fresh pinned PostgreSQL and MinIO exercise exact-byte archive, digest verification, durable object lineage, and restart recovery.
Missing, corrupt, or noncanonical objects fail closed.
The static owner OpenAPI is deep-equivalent to the live endpoint for the sealed image.
Every published route has complete authentication, request, response, error, idempotency, and example contracts.
The owner publishes a machine-readable metric catalog with exact family name, type, unit, and bounded labels for every production process.
A live scrape from each process matches that catalog, every alert and dashboard query resolves to it, and forbidden high-cardinality labels are absent.
Hosted services start and pass readiness with a read-only root filesystem and no DATA_DIR application-state authority.
Canonical mutable state is PostgreSQL or content-addressed object storage under the active fence.
Wallet, tenant, room, node, and allocation identities are server-bound and authorization is enforced on every scoped route.
Cross-tenant, cross-room, replayed, rotated, expired, and under-scoped credentials are denied.
All safety-critical reads use independently identified L1 providers with disagreement and staleness fail-closed behavior.
Production writers use only owner-durable nonce, exact-byte, remote-signer, receipt, finality, and post-finality audit paths.
Canonical facts are reconciled against independent RPC evidence and finalized floors rather than caller assertions.
Reorg, contradiction, and post-finality surprise paths retract or enter RECOVERY_REQUIRED without silently continuing.
Every public, internal, worker, queue, prover, managed-L1, and signer hop emits structured low-cardinality records joined by one sanitized correlation ID.
The effective correlation ID is returned to the caller; spoofed, malformed, and conflicting incoming IDs cannot split or confuse the trace.
Secrets, raw transactions, witness bytes, proof bytes, tenant IDs, room IDs, job IDs, and transaction hashes are not metric labels.
Register, quarantine, recover, drain, and retire transitions are exercised through the published owner and capacity-provider APIs.
Retirement is blocked while active allocations remain and succeeds only after finalized canonical lifecycle evidence.

The owner capability manifest explicitly maps tenant, entitlement, sponsorship execution, finality-oracle, and provider-payout responsibilities to runnable entrypoints or to named coordinator-integrated logical services.

Coordinator-integrated tenant and entitlement APIs have scoped auth and live route evidence; signer or executor responsibilities use distinct runnable scoped workers and cannot be satisfied by disabled placeholder Deployments or conformance stubs.
Aggregate publication uses an owner-published scoped API and service role; callers cannot supply calldata, nonce, sender, canonical outcome, or finality facts.
Exact bytes, aggregate/member lineage, durable nonce/retry state, canonical receipt, finality, reorg, crash, and post-finality recovery are exercised.
Sponsorship L1 writes use an owner-published scoped API and signer identity distinct from payout, liveness, settlement, finality, and withdrawal.
Reservation, successful consumption, failure release, retry transfer, reorg refund or credit, idempotency, and overbooking denial are exercised.
Withdrawal claims use one fenced owner-published auto-claimer path and a dedicated scoped signer; tenant proof, request, and status APIs remain in the coordinator.
Canonical root/floor binding, exact leaf/tree/proof/calldata, durable nonce and claim leases, replay denial, external-race evidence, restart, reorg, and post-finality recovery are exercised.

The source-bound packaged prover-agent image preserves one correlation ID and the owner-issued tenant, room, job, lease, and attempt context across lease, prover start, heartbeat, completion, and failure records.
A live owner queue plus real prover run proves the trace join across coordinator, agent, prover, durable heartbeat operation, and final status; missing or conflicting context fails closed.
Production proving uses only the coordinator PostgreSQL and object-store queue; no standalone or file queue participates.
The prover agent uses a prove-agent-scoped node token and coordinator-mediated l1-liveness principal, with no raw key, direct signer, or direct L1 RPC authority.
A real app-node engine creates current zkVM BatchInputV5 witnesses, submits to the durable owner queue, uses an authenticated external prover, and publishes RoomManager.submitBatch.
The content-derived acceptance token binds the exact current source bytes and proves restart-resume plus finalized canonical evidence; fixture preparation and hosted legacy Groth16 are false.
